pins.head: ONE POUR, ONE SET
pins.title: Resin Art for Beginners: Pour a Whole Set of Coasters at Once
pins.desc: Resin art for beginners works best when the first project is small and finishes in one sitting. Mix enough for every mold in the set so the color runs the same through all of them, keep a jar of stir sticks and a spare cup within reach, and leave the pour alone until it is fully cured. Lift one out early and you get a soft, tacky edge you cannot sand away. Contains affiliate links. #ResinArt #DIYCoasters #ResinCrafts
pins.alt: A stack of four teal, white and gold resin coasters with wavy agate edges on a pale oak table, with a corked glass jar of wooden stir sticks beside them and a round white silicone mold standing behind.

pins.head: LET THE CUP STAND
pins.title: Resin Bubbles: Stir Slowly, Then Let the Cup Stand Before You Pour
pins.desc: Resin bubbles come from the stir, not from the mold. Scrape the sides slowly instead of whipping air in, then set the cup down for a few minutes and watch the bubbles climb to the surface on their own. A torch passed over the poured piece clears what is left, but it cannot fix resin that was beaten into foam in the cup. Contains affiliate links. #EpoxyResin #ResinTips #CraftRoom
pins.alt: A clear cup of amber resin with a wooden stir stick laid across the rim, standing on a black honeycomb silicone mat beside an empty clear cup, with a small butane torch lying in front of them.

pins.head: THE SPARE BLANKETS GO UNDER
pins.title: Small Apartment Organization: Store Off-Season Bedding Under the Bed
pins.desc: Small apartment organization usually means finding storage that was already there. The gap under a bed holds the blankets and knitwear you only want for part of the year, and clear lidded boxes let you see which one holds what without pulling both out. A caddy hooked over the side of the mattress keeps the things you reach for at night off the nightstand. Contains affiliate links. #SmallBedroom #UnderBedStorage #ApartmentLiving
pins.alt: A small bedroom with sage green linen bedding on a grey upholstered bed, two clear lidded boxes of folded cream knit blankets pulled out from underneath, a dark grey caddy hanging off the side of the mattress and a pale wood nightstand with a cream ceramic lamp.

pins.head: TIE TWO ROLLS TOGETHER
pins.sub: Small Gifts a Cutter Owner Uses
pins.title: Gifts for Crafters: Vinyl Rolls and the Small Tools That Go With Them
pins.desc: Gifts for crafters land better when they are things that get used up. Two rolls of vinyl in colors they would not buy for themselves, tied together with a ribbon, cost less than a gadget and leave nothing to store. Add a squeegee, a roll of transfer tape and a weeding hook, and the whole set fits in a stocking. Contains affiliate links. #GiftsForCrafters #CricutProjects #StockingStuffers
pins.alt: A flat lay on crumpled oatmeal linen: a green vinyl roll and a red vinyl roll tied together with a red satin bow, a grey and black felt squeegee, a roll of clear transfer tape, a pink-handled weeding hook, and a pine sprig with two small pine cones above them.

pins.head: PRESSURE, NOT SCREWS
pins.sub: A Rod, Some Hooks, One Rack
pins.title: Renter Friendly Storage: Fill an Alcove Without Drilling Anything
pins.desc: Renter friendly storage is about pressure and gravity rather than screws. A tension rod wedged across a shallow alcove turns dead wall into a shelf for folded towels, a hook rail that hangs over the door carries bags without touching the paint, and a freestanding basket rack fills the floor below. Everything lifts out again the day you hand the keys back. Contains affiliate links. #RenterFriendly #NoDrill #SmallSpaceStorage
pins.alt: A shallow white alcove with folded cream towels resting on a white rod wedged across it, a three-tier grey metal rack of woven water-hyacinth baskets on the floor below, and an open white panelled door at the right with a canvas tote hanging from a row of hooks.

pins.head: MATTE BLACK THAT LIFTS OFF
pins.sub: A Removable Roll to Keep Handy
pins.title: Cricut Vinyl Tips: Keep One Removable Roll on the Shelf
pins.desc: Cricut vinyl tips rarely mention the roll you reach for when the project is temporary. Removable vinyl holds on a painted wall, a window or a rented cupboard door and peels away later without lifting the finish, and matte black suits lettering and labels where a glossy roll would throw back the light. Keep one beside the permanent rolls. Contains affiliate links. #VinylCrafts #CricutVinyl #LabelIdeas
pins.alt: A matte black vinyl roll standing upright on a pale oak table, partly unrolled so a sheet curls down showing its grey backing, with a green cutting mat behind it and a small pair of scissors at the right.
